snippet.title: LittleBigPlanet: PS Vita: DC Comics Premium Level Pack
snippet.description:
Click here for Timecodes: 

03:38 - Wall Jump Tutorial
05:38 - No Pause on Paradise Island
15:53 - Hero Cape Tutorial
17:34 - Toxic Terror!
31:08 - Heat Ray Tutorial
33:03 - A Frosty Reception
46:01 - Green Lantern Material Tutorial
47:46 - Mecha-Lex Madness

Welcome back to LittleBigPlanet!

This is the DC Comics Premium Level Pack DLC. This pack is on both the PS3 and Vita, and features 4 story levels, and a side level I don't record.

NOTE: This DLC is NOT cross-buy, and is DIFFERENT to the PS3 Version. While it maintains the same story line, the levels are different. 

This will not be 100% walkthrough, as you need to replay levels multiple times, and have at least one other player. I will be covering all the main levels of the story, and any future DLC content.
